description: This is a shell script used for generating FIT (Flattened Image Tree) images for U-Boot firmware; it supports multi-configuration and multi-image features such as kernel, device tree blob, and ramdisk, including hashing, compression, and signature options.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script and exits.

methods.name: array_check
methods.description: Checks if the specified array index is within valid bounds.

methods.name: array_put
methods.description: Assigns or appends a value to the specified array element.

methods.name: array_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an array element.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set configuration variables and populate image and configuration arrays.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Validates input values for signature, hash, and compression options.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Outputs sections of the FIT image configuration, such as header, images, configurations, and end.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Generates the device tree node for a kernel image.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Generates the device tree node for a flatten device tree blob.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Generates the device tree node for a ramdisk image.

methods.name: emit_cksum
methods.description: Generates checksum subnodes for image verification.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Generates signature subnodes for secure boot verification.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Outputs configuration subnodes within the FIT image.

methods.name: remove_prefix_space
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates all image nodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) in the FIT configuration.

methods.name: emit_configuration_nodes
methods.description: Generates all configuration nodes in the FIT image.
